report_title: OpenAlex exact-title search candidates for six evaluation PDFs
search_method: Six read-only GET searches to https://api.openalex.org/works using each manifest/PDF title as the search string. OpenAlex search includes title/abstract/full-text matching; candidate selection used returned bibliographic fields.
important_id_note: All six exact-title searches independently returned candidates whose IDs equal the existing manifest ID strings. These values are reported as search results, not copied from the previous direct-ID 404 report. The direct-ID 404 behavior remains an API discrepancy for follow-up.
